domains.name: Understanding the foundations of AI governance
Understanding how laws, standards and frameworks apply to AI
Understanding how to govern AI development
Understanding how to govern AI deployment and use

targetScores.mock1: >=60% overall and >=55% on Domains III and IV (else fallback course + book 10 Nov)
targetScores.mock2: >=70% overall, no domain <65% (>=75% counts toward the booking rule)
targetScores.bookingRule: Mocks #2 and #3 (two consecutive) >=75% with no domain <65-70% AND IAPP official >=70-75%

weeks.theme: Blueprint, diagnostic, Domain I (governance programme) and EU AI Act orientation

tasks.title: Read the AIGP BoK v2.1 PDF: all four domains' competencies and performance indicators; tag each line Strong / Partial / Weak against your BlueDot background
Request the free IAPP AIGP study guide (form); check it shows the 4-domain structure before using it
Read the IAPP Candidate Handbook PDF: scheduling, rescheduling/cancellation cut-offs, ID rules, OnVUE requirements. Note the reschedule cut-off: it sets your real go/no-go date
Read EU AI Act Article 4 (AI literacy duty)
Watch 'AIGP v2.1 Full Course Update Explained' (what changed in v2.1)
Diagnostic part 1: IAPP free study guide sample questions, untimed
Diagnostic part 2: AIGP Playbook 15-question free mock preview, untimed
Start a gap log: tag every diagnostic miss by BoK competency and rank the four domains weakest to strongest
Read Commission Guidelines on the AI-system definition: the 7 definitional elements only (fast)
Skim OECD AI Principles: 5 values-based principles + 5 recommendations (fast, BlueDot-covered)
Read Veronica Lin's 'How I passed the AIGP exam' (what worked, what didn't)
Read AIGP Playbook Domain I notes: skim I.A; study I.B (roles, committees, cross-functional collaboration, AI literacy) and I.C (policies across the lifecycle)
Make Anki flashcards: Domain I roles, governance committee/RACI, policy types, AI inventory
Listen: AIGP Audio Course Ep. 1, decoding the exam blueprint
Read NIST AI RMF Playbook GOVERN 1-6 (policies, accountability, workforce, culture, stakeholder engagement, third-party risk)
Listen: AIGP Audio Course Ep. 11, updating privacy, security, data-governance and IP policies for AI (I.C.2)
Read IAPP AI Governance Profession Report 2025: where governance sits, team structures
Rest day: no study
Read IAPP AI Governance in Practice Report 2024: programme set-up sections (governance structures, inventories, risk assessment)
Read the IAPP Key Terms for AI Governance glossary end to end; flag unfamiliar terms
Skim NIST AI 600-1 GenAI Profile Section 2 (the 12 GAI risks); BlueDot-covered, just map names
Read the EU AI Act high-level summary (whole page): risk tiers, provider vs deployer duties, GPAI
Read EU AI Act Article 3 definitions: points (1) AI system, (3) provider, (4) deployer, (5)-(7) authorised rep/importer/distributor, (63)-(66) GPAI
Make Anki flashcards from ~40 flagged glossary terms (IAPP wording) + the Art 3 role definitions
Week 1 recap: Anki review of all Week 1 cards + write a one-page Domain I summary from memory
Skim Oliver Patel's Unofficial AIGP Resource Guide and bookmark links for your Weak competencies

weeks.theme: First pass: GDPR for AI, Domain III (governing development) and Domain IV (governing deployment)

tasks.title: Read NIST AI RMF 1.0 PDF Part 1, Section 3 (7 trustworthy-AI characteristics) and Section 5 overview of the Core
Read the AIRC AI RMF Core page: Govern/Map/Measure/Manage and their category IDs (GOVERN 1-6, MAP 1-5, MEASURE 1-4, MANAGE 1-4)
Read GDPR Article 5 (principles): note how purpose limitation and minimisation bite on AI training data
Read GDPR Article 6 (lawful bases): legitimate interest vs consent for training and deployment
Watch 'NIST AI RMF deep dive: GOVERN vs MAP vs MEASURE vs MANAGE'
Read NIST AI RMF Playbook MAP 1-5 (context, categorisation, capabilities, risks/benefits, impacts): the design-stage checklist
Read EU AI Act Article 9 (risk management system for high-risk AI)
Read EU AI Act Article 10 (data and data governance: training, validation, test sets; bias examination)
Read GDPR Article 22 (automated individual decision-making, incl. profiling)
Add MAP categories, Art 9 steps and Art 10 data duties to Anki
Read ICO guidance: 'How should we assess security and data minimisation in AI?'
Read Datasheets for Datasets (Gebru et al.): abstract + the question sets (motivation, composition, collection, preprocessing, uses)
Read Model Cards for Model Reporting (Mitchell et al.): abstract + the model-card sections
Make Anki flashcards: Domain III lifecycle stages and the artefact produced at each (intake form, impact assessment, datasheet, model card, test report)
Read NIST AI RMF Playbook MEASURE 1-4 (metrics, TEVV, bias/fairness, feedback); skim the eval parts you know from BlueDot
Read NIST AI RMF Playbook MANAGE 1-4 (risk response, third-party risk, post-deployment monitoring, incident communication)
Read GDPR Article 35 (DPIA: when required, minimum contents)
Read OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications 2025: LLM01-LLM10 titles + mitigations
Rest day: no study
Read EU AI Act Article 26 (obligations of deployers of high-risk AI)
Read EU AI Act Article 27 (fundamental rights impact assessment)
Work through the ICO AI and data protection risk toolkit: its risk areas and example controls
Read IAPP: 'EU model contractual clauses for AI procurement: a practical guide' (vendor terms, IV.B)
Make Anki flashcards: deployer duties, FRIA, DPIA triggers, vendor contract terms
Watch 'AIGP How They Passed - July 2026' (the only v2.1-era candidate panel)
Read Singapore Model AI Governance Framework for Agentic AI: agent risks and controls sections (agentic architectures are new in v2.1, IV.A)
Complete Canada's Algorithmic Impact Assessment tool for one invented scenario (e.g., benefits-eligibility triage)
Try AI Career Pro's free practice exam / free Domain I-A trial; judge whether the items feel IAPP-like before buying
Week 2 recap: cumulative Anki review (Weeks 1-2)
Read IAPP: 'EDPB weighs in on key questions on personal data in AI models'
Drill 20 OpenExamPrep questions untimed (Domains III-IV)

weeks.theme: EU AI Act article-level deep dive, Mock #1, book the exam, standards (II.C, II.D)

tasks.title: Read AIGP Playbook Domain II notes: II.A (privacy law) and II.B (other laws) sections
Read EU AI Act Article 5 (the prohibited practices)
Read EU AI Act Article 6 (high-risk classification rules, incl. the Art 6(3) derogation and profiling carve-back)
Read EU AI Act Annex III (the 8 high-risk use-case areas)
Read IAPP Top 10 EU AI Act: 'Understanding and assessing risk'
Skim the Commission Guidelines on prohibited AI practices: worked examples for each Art 5 ban
Buy ONE v2.1 practice bank: AI Career Pro ($99, 5 full mocks) if its free trial felt IAPP-like; otherwise one Udemy v2.1 bank on sale
Read EU AI Act Chapter III Section 2 (Arts 8-15 high-risk requirements), focusing on Arts 11 technical documentation, 12 record-keeping, 13 transparency to deployers
Read EU AI Act Article 14 (human oversight)
Read EU AI Act Article 25 (value chain: when a deployer/distributor becomes a provider)
Read 'Why I failed the AIGP exam' (FAIR Institute): answer as the ideal governance function, not the pragmatic operator
Read IAPP Top 10 EU AI Act: 'Subject matter, definitions, key actors and scope'
Read EU AI Act Article 50 (transparency: chatbots, synthetic content, deepfakes, emotion recognition)
Read EU AI Act Article 99 (penalty tiers: EUR35m/7%, EUR15m/3%, EUR7.5m/1%)
Read the AI Act implementation timeline: ORIGINAL dates (2 Feb 2025, 2 Aug 2025, 2 Aug 2026, 2 Aug 2027)
Read Morgan Lewis on the Digital Omnibus: NEW dates (Annex III to 2 Dec 2027, Annex I to 2 Aug 2028)
Read EU AI Act Articles 51 and 53 (systemic-risk GPAI, 10^25 FLOP presumption; GPAI provider obligations); fast, BlueDot-covered
Read IAPP Top 10 EU AI Act: 'Obligations for general-purpose AI models'
FULL MOCK #1: AI Career Pro Mock 1, 100 Qs, timed 165 min, no notes (target >=60% overall, >=55% on III and IV)
Score Mock #1 by domain; update the gap log; apply the decision rule (keep 27 Oct or move to 10 Nov? fallback course?)
Rest day: no study

BOOK THE EXAM (gated on Mock #1): >=60% and >=55% on III/IV -> book Tue 27 Oct 2026; otherwise book fallback Tue 10 Nov 2026. Book via the IAPP AIGP page, then Pearson VUE (morning slot, or take the afternoon off)
Review every Mock #1 item (right and wrong): write why each distractor is wrong
Run the EU AI Act Compliance Checker on 5 invented scenarios (HR screening, chatbot, credit scoring, emotion recognition at work, product safety component)
Make Anki flashcards from every Mock #1 miss + a two-column date card (original vs Omnibus)
Read the ISO/IEC 42001 page (AIMS scope, clause structure)
Read ISMS.online on ISO 42001 Annex A controls (A.2-A.10 objectives)
Skim the NIST AI RMF to ISO/IEC 42001 crosswalk: how the functions map to 42001 clauses
Read the ISO/IEC 42005 page (AI system impact assessment, new in v2.1)
Skim the ISO/IEC 42005 to NIST AI RMF crosswalk
Skim the IAPP US State AI Governance Legislation Tracker (which states, which models)

weeks.theme: II.A/II.B detail, Domain III deep dive, Mock #2, Domain IV deep dive

tasks.title: Read FTC 'Operation AI Comply' (Section 5 deception/unfairness applied to AI claims)
Read NYC DCWP page on Local Law 144 (AEDT bias audits, candidate notice)
Read McDermott: Colorado SB24-205 blocked, replaced by SB26-189 (eff. 1 Jan 2027); keep the developer/deployer duty-of-care concepts
Read Wittliff Cutter: Texas TRAIGA, the Colorado reset and federal preemption (2026)
Read GDPR Article 13 (incl. 'meaningful information about the logic involved')
Read FPF on South Korea's AI Framework (Basic) Act, in force 22 Jan 2026 (new in v2.1)
Read the Dec 2025 White House EO on a national AI policy framework (state-law preemption)
Read ICO Guidance on AI and data protection: accountability, lawfulness, fairness and transparency sections
Read EDPB Opinion 28/2024 executive summary (model anonymity, legitimate-interest 3-step test, consequences of unlawful training)
Read EU AI Act Article 15 (accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity) on the AI Act Service Desk
Read EU AI Act Article 43 (conformity assessment routes) as a III.C release gate
Read ICO: 'How do we ensure individual rights in our AI systems?'
Read AIGP Playbook training material: Domain III module (III.A design/build, III.B data, III.C release/monitoring/maintenance)
Read EU AI Act Articles 47 and 49 (EU declaration of conformity / CE marking; registration in the EU database)
Read IAPP Top 10 EU AI Act: 'Post-market monitoring, information sharing and enforcement'
Skim NIST AI 100-2e2025 adversarial ML taxonomy: the attack classes (evasion, poisoning, privacy, misuse)
FULL MOCK #2: AI Career Pro Mock 2, timed 165 min (target >=70% overall, no domain <65%; >=75% counts toward the booking rule)
Score Mock #2 by domain; update the gap log; pick the two weakest competencies for Week 5
Rest day: no study
Review every Mock #2 item: why each distractor is wrong
Buy the IAPP official AIGP practice exam (~$50-60, price unverified); confirm the store page references BoK v2.1
Read IAPP Top 10 EU AI Act: 'AI assurance across the risk categories'
Read Canada's Directive on Automated Decision-Making (impact levels, requirements)
Read China's Interim Measures for Generative AI Services (English translation)
Read AIGP Playbook training material: Domain IV module (IV.A deploy decision incl. agentic, IV.B assessments/vendor due diligence, IV.C monitoring, incidents, decommissioning)
Make Anki flashcards: release gates, post-market monitoring, serious-incident reporting + Mock #2 misses
Week 4 recap: cumulative Anki review (all decks)
Skim GDPR Chapter 3 (data subject rights, Arts 12-23) for AI-relevant rights: access, erasure, objection
Read the Council of Europe AI treaty (CETS 225) announcement

weeks.theme: Consolidation and exam week: Mock #3, IAPP official practice exam, go/no-go, exam Tue 27 Oct

tasks.title: FULL MOCK #3: AI Career Pro Mock 3, timed 165 min (target >=75% overall, no domain <65-70%). Block a long evening
Score Mock #3 by domain and compare with Mock #2
Review Mock #3 misses; re-read your notes on the 3 most-missed competencies
Gap closure 1 (default IV.B if the gap log agrees): re-read the IAPP guide to EU model contractual clauses; list 10 vendor due-diligence questions
Early go/no-go check on Mocks #2 and #3. If the handbook's reschedule cut-off falls before Sun 25 Oct, decide today
Read AIGP Playbook reference sheets and checklists (impact assessments, vendor review)
Gap closure 2 (default IV.C): re-read NIST Playbook MANAGE 3-4 (third-party risk, post-deployment monitoring, incident response, decommissioning)
Re-read EU AI Act Articles 25 and 26 together: build a provider vs deployer vs 'deemed provider' table
Run the OnVUE system check on the exam computer (>=48 h ahead) or confirm the test-centre route; re-read the handbook's ID and room rules
Drill 40 OpenExamPrep questions untimed on your two weakest competencies
Watch 'Top 3 Tips to Pass Your AIGP Exam on the First Try'
IAPP OFFICIAL AIGP PRACTICE EXAM: timed 165 min, exam conditions (target >=70-75%)
Score the IAPP practice exam by domain

GO/NO-GO: Mocks #2 and #3 both >=75% with no domain <65-70%, AND IAPP practice >=70-75%? Yes: keep Tue 27 Oct. No: reschedule to Tue 10 Nov (if still inside the handbook cut-off) and run the 2-week extension
Optional 20-min Anki pass (due cards only)
Review every IAPP practice-exam miss: note the qualifier (FIRST/BEST/MOST) and the lifecycle stage each item hinged on
Build your one-page cram sheet: AI Act dates (both schedules), penalty tiers, Art 5 bans, Annex III areas, impact-assessment types (DPIA/FRIA/conformity/42005/AEDT audit)
Read the AIGP Playbook exam-day revision sheet (100 essential facts by domain); star any fact you can't explain. Then stop; early night
Prepare: ID matching registration, clear desk/room (OnVUE), alarm, route
Light: re-skim only your cram sheet and the starred facts (max 20 min)
SIT THE AIGP EXAM: 100 Qs, 165 min (+ optional 15-min break; review flagged first-half items BEFORE the break)
